api: http://127.0.0.1:18201 (W4-02 seed DB) and http://127.0.0.1:9761 (W4-03 walkthrough serve, hard-coded)

differences.what: Cross-cutting, cited not re-described: B1-01/B2-01 shell top bar missing (all pairs); B1-04/B2-36 rail 'Not available yet' (all); B2-02 page-local period bar (Site-local line + raw UTC line + Day/Hour or First day/Days + Apply, all pairs); B1-07/B2-03 14 px prose (all non-refused); B1-02/B2-04 tall dark header at 390 (refused-invalid 390, about 237 px on the 900 px page); B1-53 raw codes/UUIDs (B12-10); B2-21/B3-04 is mostly closed here because the Site-local window is primary, but a raw UTC ISO line remains. B3-01 does not recur: the Site tabs and Performance subtabs match the mock.
differences.disp: Cite existing IDs. The period bar is the same page-local window seam as R88/R112 (D1, cold/EV Work): propose extending R88/R112 to the four mini Performance pages rather than a new row.

differences.what: The register has no row for any W4-02 screen, although W4-02 ruled many visible departures (Q19-Q24, q9-q12 incl. q9-8 dispatch link, q10 CTA/unbuilt tabs, q11 copy/readiness rows, q12-7 height budgets, B3 no Backup Overview card).
differences.disp: Architect registers each ruled departure (D1/D2) or reclassifies it as D3 (same pattern as B10-01).

differences.what: Status and category tones are missing. Strip chips are all neutral grey (mock: Watch amber, Lens green). Decision chips Eligible/Excluded/Conflict are grey (mock: green/grey/amber). Renewable bars are all blue (mock: amber PV, blue use, grey margin, green headroom). Service per-load bars are all blue (mock: blue/green/red).
differences.disp: D3 Low (shared tone tokens, W4 mini fix slice), or D2 if the Architect rules neutral tones deliberate.

differences.what: Mock strip has 'Confidence: Medium'. The app shows no confidence chip at all, but build spec line 51 says 'Confidence is Not assessed until an approved confidence rule exists'.
differences.disp: D3 Low (render 'Confidence: Not assessed'), or D1 with a register row if the omission was ruled later.

differences.what: In the W4-02 producer state the Productive-use panel says 'The evidence changed. Reload this page.' The cause is GET /api/sites/MG-W402-001/opportunities returning 409 PERFORMANCE_CUTOVER_CLOSED ('No Performance comparison report exists for this Site'). miniDecisionsClient.decisionRefusalCopy maps every 409 to that sentence, and reloading cannot help. With the W4-03 producer the same page shows 'Opportunity decision ->' (w403-decision-positive).
differences.disp: D3 Low-Medium: give the closed-cutover 409 code its own honest copy (for example 'Opportunity decisions are not open for this Site yet'), keyed on the error code, not the status.

differences.what: The gap window (08-12 Oct, 11 Oct unselected, 12 Oct conflict) shows the strip 'Not assessed · No selected assessment', yet the cards show 41-43 kW / 20 kW / 18-20 kW headroom / 3/3 days and the strip says 'Solar headroom on 3 of 3 assessed days'. Build spec Q19 allows that sentence only when all five days are completely assessed; otherwise it should read 'Recurrence is not established for this selection.' The table footer already does this.
differences.disp: D3 Low (status fact should follow Q19 like recurrenceText); Architect to confirm Q19 was not superseded.

differences.what: Refused window (renewable 6 days, others 2 hours; API 422 INVALID_WINDOW): the period bar and a 'Period cannot be read' box remain, but the strip, the four cards and all 3-4 mock panels are dropped (0 panels against 3-4 in the mock). This is the B6-13/B9-05 pattern, except here a banner is shown. The single server message 'Select a valid complete site-local hour or one to five site-local days.' covers distinct errors (too many days, too many hours), like the carried domainActionClient generic-window-error check.
differences.disp: Cite B6-13/B9-05 for the dropped furniture (shared ruling). Generic copy: D3 Low under the same fix owner as the domainActionClient item, or D2.

differences.what: Built destinations shown as 'Not available yet'. Renewable: 'Compare with Dispatch evidence · Not available yet' on every multi-UTC-day window (q9-8: a link only when one UTC day contains every hour), while the 1-day no-window page shows the live link. Service: 'See effect on verification · Not available yet' in every state (no exact selected Action). The mock has live links. Analogue of B7-03/B9-02. 'Not recorded' itself does not occur on these pages (0 occurrences).
differences.disp: D1 with register rows citing q9-8 and Q20. Optional D2: link Dispatch to the first day of the window.

differences.what: Mock example content replaced or relabelled. Renewable: grain-mill 10 kW x 1 h scenario becomes 'No productive-use scenario has been assessed'; 'Day N' becomes dated rows plus 'N cited records · Evidence'; an extra recurrence sentence sits under the table; the capability equation line becomes a 'Basis and coverage' disclosure. Service: role 'Unclassified load' instead of Productive use/General service; card label 'Health clinic (critical)'. Backup: column 'Current claim (latest observed outage chain)' instead of 'Current claim'; 'Browse Actions' instead of 'Open Actions'. All four: strip limitations sit behind a 'Limited by N conditions' disclosure where the mock shows them inline.
differences.disp: D1/D4 (honest replacement of illustrative facts) or D2 (wording), registered per B12-01.

differences.what: 'Where the power went' carries an inner sub-heading 'Delivered power by addressed load', which repeats the title of the next panel. The mock has none.
differences.disp: D3 Low (drop or rename the sub-heading).

differences.what: Raw identifiers on screen: service load cells append raw asset codes ('Clinic feeder delivered power · load-clinic', 'load-mill', 'load-res'); backup readiness 'Inspect IDs' disclosures list raw evidence UUIDs; the period bar prints raw UTC ISO tokens ('UTC 2026-10-06T09:00:00Z to ...').

Card headline typography. Text-valued headlines ('None seen in measured intervals', 'Delivery completeness unconfirmed', '1 witnessed success', 'No record', 'Cannot compute') are smaller than numeric ones or wrap to 2-3 lines. Card heights are unequal at 390 (service 154/154/131/131, fuel 149/149/115/115). The mock renders numeric value plus small unit ('42 kW').
differences.disp: D3 Low or D2 (same seam as B10-02 text headlines); no cap breach.

differences.what: Mini Overview (link check, not counted): the Service, Fuel and Renewable cards' 'View detail ->' land on these pages with the exact Site-local window and a pinned known_at. There is no Backup card (mock and W4-02 ruling B3 agree), so Backup is reached only through the subtab. B2-08 recurs on MG-W402-001: Dispatch and Battery cards have no link. B2-10 is unrelated to these pages. Defect: under the W4-03 producer state the Overview logs a React duplicate-key warning ('Encountered two children with the same key ... Recorded reason 1') at both widths.
differences.disp: Cite B2-08. Duplicate key: D3 Low on the `mini` screen (batch 2 owner).

differences.what: Spec route-table error: the spec names `tools/s402*` as the producer for renewable/service/fuel/backup. Those are S4-02 money tools. The real producer is W4-02 `.agent/W4-02-evidence/seed.py` with `tools/w402_mini_depth_cases.py` (and W4-03 `tools/w403_mini_decisions_walkthrough.py` for the decision CTA). The routes themselves are correct (SITE_PERFORMANCE_SUBTAB_ROUTE_PATH; `backup` shares /performance/backup with `coldbackup`, by Site type).

Measured structure: panel count, order, titles and table columns match the mock on every non-refused pair. Max panel ratio 1.14, so none exceeds 1.3x. No page horizontal overflow. 390 tables and the fuel bridge scroll internally by design (q12-7). The empty states (no-window, known-before-evidence) are honest 'No selected assessment' / 'Unknown' states with shorter panels (0.18-0.75x).
differences.disp: Informational; heights within the W4-02 Run 9 budgets.
